name: Takamisawa Kyousuke Nekketsu!! Kyouiku Kenshuu
original_name: 高見沢恭介 熱血!!教育研修
source:
Kyousuke Takamisawa is a twenty-three year old man who has been having some trouble finding a job. His last teaching experience wasn't particularly successful, and now he is out for better opportunities in the city. However, his real focus is on his charming female acquaintances - from high-school students to waitresses, neighbors, and other women populating the city.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/takamizawa-kysuke-nekketsu-kyiku-kensh]Moby Games[/url]]
